verdict.rationale: Datalab's convert endpoint and SDK document a 'chunks' output format alongside Markdown, HTML and JSON (datalab-docs-22, datalab-docs-31), so output can come pre-chunked rather than as a wall of text. The evidence only names that format and does not describe how chunks are built. Separately, the segmentation API splits documents into logical sections by page range (datalab-docs-33), which is coarser than RAG-sized chunking. Missing for 10: documentation of semantic chunk boundaries, per-chunk metadata (e.g., headings, page or bbox provenance), embedding-ready segment sizing, and hands-on corroboration.
